This is a task-evoked, whole-brain, group-level decision-making contrast relating to perceptual categorization (perceptual decision-making). It therefore meets the global decision-making and whole-brain requirements and fits the common decision-making category (covers perceptual decisions).

Study-level subtype is perceptual_dm (GLOBAL_I5) and the contrast indexes sensory/perceptual evidence (category mean/variance). Ambiguous_dm inclusion criteria (AMBIGUOUS_DM_I1/AMBIGUOUS_DM_I2) are not met; also sensory-perceptual difficulty contrasts should be assigned to perceptual_dm (AMBIGUOUS_DM_E1).
